# looker-extension-sdk (24.20.0)

## Overview
Vendored `@looker/extension-sdk@24.20.0` ES module bundle (`esm.sh`) used by the Data App runtime to connect to the Looker Extension Host and execute Looker API / tile host operations inside Looker dashboard tiles.

## Interface
- `[extension-sdk.mjs:ApiVersion, DashboardRunState, ExtensionEvent, ExtensionNotificationType, ExtensionRequestType, FetchResponseBodyType, LookerExtensionSDK, MountPoint, SdkConnection, connectExtensionHost, getExtensionSDK, logError, logWarn, registerHostApi]`: Public ES module exports for Looker Extension SDK host connection and API clients.
- Child contracts: [node](./node/EGM.md) — Browser-shimmed Node.js built-ins (`process.mjs`, `buffer.mjs`, `events.mjs`, `async_hooks.mjs`, `tty.mjs`) imported by `extension-sdk.mjs`.

## Invariants
- `[extension-sdk.mjs:header]`: Vendored output (`@looker/extension-sdk@24.20.0`, generated by `scripts/vendor-extension-sdk.sh`); do not edit by hand.
- `[extension-sdk.mjs:imports]`: Requires `./node/process.mjs` and `./node/buffer.mjs` (plus transitive `./node/events.mjs`, `./node/async_hooks.mjs`, `./node/tty.mjs`) at relative module paths.

## Side Effects
- `[extension-sdk.mjs:connectExtensionHost]`: Establishes `postMessage` / channel communication with the Looker Extension Host window when invoked by the runtime.

## Verification
- Run: `npm test`
